title: 从失语症图片命名错误剖面恢复大语言模型中的损伤参数
summary: 该研究探讨了从LLM（LLaVA-Vicuna 13B）的图片命名错误剖面逆向恢复损伤参数（层索引、修改百分比、噪声sigma）的可能性。训练多任务神经网络实现部分恢复，修改百分比和噪声可恢复，层索引仅近似。反事实验证中81.4%案例重现目标行为，表明变压器层功能冗余。应用于中风患者数据，参数具有综合征区分性。
summary_en: This study investigates recovering lesion parameters (layer index, modification percentage, noise sigma) from picture naming error profiles in LLMs (LLaVA-Vicuna 13B). A multi-task neural network partially recovers parameters: modification percentage and noise are recoverable, layer index only approximately. Counterfactual validation reproduces target behavior in 81.4% cases, indicating functional redundancy across transformer layers. Applied to stroke patient data, parameters are syndrome-discriminative.
